entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 659744295638254336: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.5520 +/- 0.0630 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 180.11 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -35.776, -12.274 mas/yr. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.4 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract). Mass 0.41 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.509.1075C/abstract). Temperature 3566 +/- 34 K from Castro-González et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,566 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc98f. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,566 K and log g 4.85 (u1 0.386, u2 0.378): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
